routineApprovalRequiredWhy: Set true on 2026-08-29. A human release gate was introduced 2026-08-27 (data/admin/publication_approvals.json + scripts/admin/approve_publication.mjs) requiring a named human before anything publishes. This flag said false, so the contract and the gate asserted opposite things and the validators enforced the false one. Autonomy still covers discovery, drafting, validation and repair - approval is required only at the release boundary.
